events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hello, my name is Theo Lindquist. Date of birth? November 2nd, 1979. I missed my metformin this morning. Can I take two tablets tonight instead ?
One moment while I check your details.
I’ve sent your question to the prescribing team; your reference is Q N, four two one zero. A clinician will answer, and I cannot give dose advice or change the record.
Bouquet. Please also send a refill request for my metformin .
I can send a request about this recorded medication, metformin five hundred milligram tablets, one tablet twice a day with meals, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Right, I'll send that request for review.
Your refill request reference is R Q, one zero one four. It is awaiting prescribing team review.
